backend/main.mo: Motoko canister providing user profiles, authorization gates, media publishing for hero image, images, videos, and background song, plus versioning and deployment structs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file including components, hooks, config, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based OKLCH theme variables with light/dark palettes and base style resets.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/public/PLACEHOLDER_MEDIA_README: Instructions explaining upload-only media behavior, supported types, empty states, persistence, and Media Manager usage.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app orchestrating lock screen, intro, proposal popup flow, media manager, ambient effects, and content sections.
frontend/src/components/FlipImageCard.ts: 3D flip card component showing an uploaded image on the front and a romantic message on the back with keyboard and tap support.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Ambient visual component rendering floating heart animations across the screen.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with background image, media manager button, and decorative birthday text; supports uploading a custom background.
frontend/src/components/ImageAdjustModal: Modal for zooming, panning, and resetting image transforms before saving changes.
frontend/src/components/ImageMemorySecti: Displays a grid of memory images with optional flip-card messages and empty-slot placeholders.
frontend/src/components/IntroPopup.tsx: Intro popup overlay with decorative visuals and a single close button.
frontend/src/components/LockScreen.tsx: Password lock screen with emoji animations and error-shake feedback on incorrect input.
Typing‑effect popup that displays a long love letter with a close button and scrollable content.
frontend/src/components/MediaManager.tsx: Full media management dialog for editing hero, images, videos, song, ordering, transforms, and publishing with precheck support.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: Interactive audio player that auto-plays if possible, handles song type detection, and offers play/pause controls with UI states.
frontend/src/components/ProposalPopup.ts: Popup modal showing a proposal message with animated ring emojis and a secondary surprise popup.
frontend/src/components/RosePetals.tsx: Renders animated falling rose petals using randomized positions and animation timings.
Section with buttons that trigger opening a love letter or proposal popup.
frontend/src/components/VideoMemorySecti: Displays a grid of up to six videos with mute controls, showing upload prompts for empty slots.
frontend/src/config/imageMemory.ts: Generates 43 image memory items, each paired with a looping romantic message.
frontend/src/config/romanticMessages.ts: Array of customizable romantic messages used for image memory cards.
frontend/src/config/videoMemory.ts: Defines six video memory slots with simple ID-based configuration.
frontend/src/context/MediaStoreContext.t: Context provider managing media state, uploads, backend sync, and transforms for images, videos, and audio.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks to manage Internet Identity authentication via AuthClient, including loading, login, logout, and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaDraft.ts: Manages media draft state including hero, images, videos, song, ordering, transforms, and drag interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaManagerPermis: Fetches and exposes user permissions for media management based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useMediaStore.ts: Re-exports the MediaStore context hook for accessing shared media state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublishWithPrechec: Handles pre-publish checks and publishing media changes with error normalization and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionGate.ts: Provides a simple session-based password gate using sessionStorage to unlock access.
frontend/src/hooks/useTypingText.ts: Implements a typing animation hook that progressively reveals text at a configurable speed.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styling with custom romantic-themed colors and animations.
frontend/src/lib/deployDiagnostics.ts: Utility for normalizing errors into diagnostic payloads and formatting them for console or user display.
frontend/src/lib/localMediaStore.ts: IndexedDB-based storage layer for saving, retrieving, and clearing hero, image, video, and song media blobs locally.
frontend/src/lib/mediaDiagnostics.ts: Defines diagnostic types and logs app start and submit summaries without exposing media content.
frontend/src/lib/publishedMediaClient.ts: Uploads media changes to the backend with slot validation, progress callbacks, and optional clearing.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage fallback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, layout, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project state, features, issues, and architectural notes for the media web app.
